description: This Java class, PatientValidator, is a source file that defines a validator for Patient objects within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It extends PersonValidator and adds specific validation logic for patient attributes such as gender, identifiers, and status indicators.

classes.name: PatientValidator
classes.description: A validator class for Patient objects in the OpenMRS system, responsible for validating patient-specific fields such as gender and identifiers, extending PersonValidator for common person validation.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the validator supports a given class, specifically supports Patient class or subclasses.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on a Patient object, including gender, identifiers, and other constraints. Uses Errors object to accumulate validation errors.
